_doc: Models an agent seat may switch to that are not in config/providers.json, per runtime. They are seat-only: providers.json is also Arturo's brain catalog, whose model ids cannot carry the [1m] suffix (services/arturo/brain.py). Read by scripts/agent_model.py (SEAT_MODELS, GET /api/agents/:id/model) and by the API's GET /api/runtimes/available, which lists them marked seat_only with seat_only_reason so Arturo's picker can dim them. One list, so the two cannot drift.
seat_only_reason: Only for agents; Arturo can't use the 1M versions
